column1: # Authzed (SpiceDB schema): definition (class), caveat (function), and inside a definition each relation (field) and permission (method).
# Not listed: subject types, caveat references, names used in permission expressions.
# Relations written 'name: type' are not listed: the grammar puts the colon into the name. See KNOWN_GAPS.md.
# network.zed and numerals.zed are not listed: the grammar cannot parse an ipaddress parameter or a name with a number in it. See KNOWN_GAPS.md.
